Enrich person.name: Brian Downer
Enrich person.title: EVP, Head of Enterprise Corporate Services
Enrich person.summary:
Brian Downer is executive vice president and head of Enterprise Corporate Services (ECS) for Truist.  He is responsible for a broad array of enterprise functions and initiatives including Third-Party Management, Corporate Real Estate and Workplace Management, Corporate Security, Global Service Delivery, Corporate Travel Services, Truist Store and Contingent Workforce. 

Since joining Truist in 2019 as Chief Procurement Officer, he has developed and implemented Truist’s third-party management strategy and corporate services programs aligned to Truist’s strategy. Downer emphasizes sustainability, supplier development, and inclusive sourcing based on service excellence, risk management, innovation, and value creation. With more than 30 years of banking experience, he previously served as Chief Procurement Officer for State Street Bank.

Downer currently serves as Treasurer and executive committee member on the Board of Directors for the National Minority Supplier Development Council. He is a member of the Chief Procurement Officer Council for Ariel Investments Project Black. Passionate about philanthropy and community engagement, he also serves in various capacities with other national and regional non-profit and small business advocacy organizations. 

A native of Massachusetts, Downer earned a bachelor’s degree with a finance concentration from Merrimack College. Outside of work, he enjoys sports, music, and spending time with family.

Enrich person.name: Dino Harapas
Enrich person.title: Head of Strategic Workforce Planning and Business Insights
Enrich person.summary:
As the Enterprise Strategic Workforce Planning and Business Insights Leader at Truist, our team leads enterprise-wide workforce planning and human capital analytics strategies that align talent capabilities and business insights with strategic objectives. The team delivers data-driven insights through advanced workforce planning and human capital analytics. Our work informs executive decision-making, supports risk management and regulatory compliance, and enables proactive talent planning to ensure the right staffing levels and skillsets are in place for future growth. By partnering across HR, Finance, Risk, and Business Leadership, our teams serve as trusted strategic partners on workforce optimization and organizational effectiveness - driving measurable impact through strategic planning and analytical insights.

Additionally, our team of Human Capital Analytics professionals focuses on enabling Truist’s enterprise workforce analytics strategy. We apply both quantitative and qualitative methods to deliver insights that improve individual, team, and organizational performance. Our work supports senior HR and business leaders in integrating data into daily decision-making and long-term strategic planning. We also deliver human capital insights that inform Enterprise and Functional Risk Committees, the Board of Directors, and executive leadership.

In my 10+ years at Truist prior to leading the SWFP and Human Capital Analytics teams, I managed compliance risk for Human Resources and Legal, establishing a foundational compliance culture to ensure appropriate compliance risk oversight is in place for adherence to all regulatory requirements; I helped define and create Truist's talent strategy, philosophy, and talent-related analytics in year one after the SunTrust/BB&T-merger; and I spent a year enabling the SunTrust/BB&T merger across the Human Resources workstream, laying the foundation for the Truist HR function.

As a Senior Technology Executive, I specialize in orchestrating the complex symphony of people, platforms, and processes that power enterprise-scale infrastructure. At Truist, I’m driving change through a strategy built on five pillars:

•	Simplification — streamlining products, vendors, and cost structures for clarity and efficiency.
•	Innovation — applying emerging technologies, from AI to automation, to create competitive advantage.

I thrive at the intersection of technology strategy, execution, and leadership, with a clear eye on shaping the future of banking infrastructure.

My passion is simple: building the future of enterprise IT — and bringing people along for the journey.
